description:
Recover the file 'Project_Alpha_Budget.csv' from the encrypted volume '/home/ga/Documents/project_alpha.hc'. The volume's password was recently changed and is lost, but you have a backup of the previous header at '/home/ga/Documents/alpha_header.bak' which uses the password 'BackupPass123'. 

Your goal is to mount the volume using the external header backup to access the data WITHOUT permanently restoring the header to the volume file (non-destructive recovery). 

1. Mount the volume using the 'Use header file...' option in Mount Options.
2. Recover 'Project_Alpha_Budget.csv' to '/home/ga/Documents/Recovered/'.
3. Dismount the volume.

Do NOT use the 'Restore Volume Header' tool, as this would revert the volume's current state.
